# Evidence atlas summary

This page is a generated, browsable rendering of every row in
[`data/derived/evidence_atlas.csv`](https://github.com/fraware/lab-automation-observatory/blob/main/data/derived/evidence_atlas.csv). It exists so a reader can scan all ten
constructs without opening a spreadsheet. For what a row means, how to trace
it back to quotes, cases, and metrics, and what it does not support, read
[Evidence atlas](../evidence-atlas.md) first.

Regenerate with `make atlas-summary` (also run as part of `make derived`), or
directly with `uv run python scripts/build_atlas_summary.py`.
